_what: Provenance sweep of every workflow in the n8n instance: is it skill-built (meta.aiBuilderAssisted==true AND meta.builderVariant=='mcp'), and does it reach ERP (erpbackendpro.maids.cc / erp.maids.cc in an httpRequest-family node url, or via helpers.httpRequest inside a Code node). Covers all 103 register rows: the 74 needing verification were fetched live via get_workflow_details; the other 29 were resolved for PROVENANCE, which the register never recorded - 26 offline from their saved exports and 3 fetched live.
_method: skill_built is decided ONLY by meta.aiBuilderAssisted && meta.builderVariant=='mcp' - never by name, tag or date. 'unreachable' means get_workflow_details refused with 'Workflow is not available in MCP' (availableInMCP not enabled); those are NOT judged, not assumed.
_caveats: The provenance marker does NOT survive duplication in the n8n UI: SDR Gatherer v2 (3ISVEAzkHcryZdTk) is a near-clone of the skill-built SDR Deterministic Gatherer but carries meta:null. A false 'no' is therefore possible for any copied flow.

erp=true is reserved for a real ERP HTTP call. A workflow that only mentions an ERP host in a non-url parameter (a deep-link built for a report) is recorded under erp_mentions_non_url, not counted as reaching ERP.
ERP endpoints also appear as langchain toolHttpRequest AI-agent tools (TYUliva3dhgWqSAS). Those reach ERP with call volume chosen by an LLM at runtime.

32 of 103 workflows could not be read at all - get_workflow_details refuses them with 'Workflow is not available in MCP'. Their provenance and ERP status are UNKNOWN, not clean. This is the single largest blind spot in the sweep and includes ACTIVE flows the register believes reach ERP (Dh7z2BbbZhP9gLmT LAWP Reservoir Audit, crIE9qL0v58lmq0G Extract from Payroll).
